name: The Fargodeep Mine
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The mine in Northshire isn't the only one with problems!  I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.

Explore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me.  The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.
narrative.objectives: Explore the Fargodeep Mine, then return to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
narrative.offerRewardText: This is bad news. What's next, dragons?!? We'll have to increase our patrols near that mine. Thanks for your efforts, adventurer. And hold a moment... I might have another task for you.
narrative.requestItemsText: What do you have to report, adventurer? Have you been to the Fargodeep Mine?
